verdict.rationale: Docs clearly cover creating a session (v1sessions), polling decision status, and webhooks for events/decisions, giving strong support for the create-and-status portion of the lifecycle. However, there is no documented API endpoint for retrieving captured media, nor for cancelling or redacting a session — those actions only appear tied to the manual Customer Portal UI, not the API. missing for 10: API endpoint for retrieving captured media, API endpoint for session cancellation, API endpoint for data redaction/deletion, independent corroboration of full lifecycle via API only.
